evidenceBoundary: This packet's three scopes are governance scopes: an owner decision (Scope 1), an upstream routing of a registry wiring-description defect (Scope 2), and a disposition of a historical certification (Scope 3). Their proof surface is inspection of recorded artifacts and replay of the G087 guard - not product runtime behavior. Scope 1's Test Plan records static checks against design.md (the ruling text it asserts), not executable product tests; the scenarios keep an empty linkedTests array because no test FILE is authored by this packet, and naming one would be a fabricated reference.
